intended_use: Reference data for cat-related plant toxicity lookup after a plant has been identified. Not a diagnostic or emergency-care tool.

status_definitions.toxic: The cited source explicitly lists the matched plant taxon as toxic to cats.
status_definitions.non_toxic: The cited source explicitly lists the matched plant taxon as non-toxic to cats. This is not a guarantee that ingestion cannot cause illness. ASPCA-listed non-toxic entries are reference classifications, not a guarantee against irritation or illness.
status_definitions.unknown: The source does not establish a class-wide status, or the class-to-source taxon match is too broad or uncertain. Do not interpret as safe.

general_note: Toxicity depends on the plant taxon and exposure. Common names can refer to different plants. If ingestion is suspected, contact a veterinarian or animal poison-control service; do not rely on this file for treatment decisions.
